title: Competitor pricing & positioning teardown
summary: Paste a competitor's website and get their pricing, positioning, key messages and the angles to counter them.
seoTitle: Competitor Pricing & Positioning Teardown with AI
answer: This template reads a competitor's homepage and pricing page, extracts their pricing tiers, positioning statement, target audience, key messaging and feature claims, then produces a structured teardown report with recommended counter-positioning angles. The AI agent analyzes how they position against your product (when you provide context) and suggests where you have differentiation opportunities or pricing advantages.

faq.q: Can competitive intelligence tools do this natively?
faq.a: Most competitive intelligence platforms track pricing changes over time and alert you to website updates, but they do not read a competitor's messaging and suggest counter-positioning angles. This template combines research with strategic analysis in one workflow.

faq.q: What pages does the template read?
faq.a: The workflow reads the competitor's homepage and pricing page. You can edit the read_site step to add more pages like /features or /about if your competitive analysis needs them.

faq.q: How do I customize the teardown focus?
faq.a: Edit the competitor-analyst agent instructions to emphasize the dimensions you care about: pricing, feature parity, messaging tone, target segments, GTM motion, or differentiation gaps.

faq.q: Can I run this on multiple competitors at once?
faq.a: No. The template processes one competitor per run to keep the teardown focused. Run it multiple times or extend the playbook to loop over a list if you need batch analysis.

faq.q: What happens if the pricing page is not public?
faq.a: If pricing requires login or a sales call, the agent notes that in the teardown and analyzes positioning and messaging only. You can manually add known pricing details as input context.

sampleOutput: Competitor: Acme Insights | Pricing: $49/user/mo (Pro), $99/user/mo (Enterprise) | Positioning: AI-powered analytics for product teams | Target: Mid-market SaaS | Counter angles: They focus on dashboards, we deliver action. Their pricing scales per seat, ours is usage-based and cheaper for small teams. Built by the Brainfish team.
whatYouNeed: Competitor website URL, optional one-line description of your product
failureHandling: If the competitor site cannot be reached or the pricing page is not found, the workflow notes this in the teardown and continues with available information. No retries since this is a manual run.
nativeVsTemplate: Use a competitive intelligence platform when you need continuous monitoring and historical tracking. Use this template when you want an on-demand strategic teardown with AI analysis of messaging, positioning fit, and actionable counter-positioning advice.
setup: Import the template. No apps or secrets are required.
Run it with a competitor's website, and optionally a one-line description of your product.
Edit the `competitor-analyst` agent to focus on the angles your team cares about.
